name: Gfx_Bch_MaterialCommandSize

evidence: NEW: the request helper is now the confident Svc_SendRequestArg and the return is visibly (result >> 31) + 1, so this is a lock-protected service query; the address sits in the DSP/sound block next to Snd_Initialize, which is why the first-pass 'Gfx_QueryDisplayInfo' is dropped - the service is not identified by name, so maybe_ stays.
